Title: Ireland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Single Party Framework Agreement for Architect Led Integrated Design Team Services for Fire Safety Remediation Works for Dublin City Council
Procedure title: Single Party Framework Agreement for Architect Led Integrated Design Team Services for Fire Safety Remediation Works for Dublin City Council
Description: Dublin City Council proposes to engage in a competitive process to establish a single party framework agreement for architect led Integrated design team services, for Dublin City Council, to deliver the fire Safety remediation of buildings of a variety of uses under Dublin City Council ownership or partial ownership. The single party framework agreement will be established on foot of an initial contract for whole stages (Stage (i) Preliminary – Stage (v) Handover of Works) delivery of professional services in relation to the fire remediation works at a 7 storey mixed use development in Dublin City Centre, consisting of 62 residential apartments, retail units, podium car-park and approximately 3,000sqm of community facilities. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 8836259. Please note that this project is subject to funding.
